card.name: Human milk in nursing-mother statements
card.fires_on: The word milk (or the start of excreted, or feeding) in sentences about whether a drug is excreted in human milk, usually in Nursing Mothers sections.

modes.label: Milk after excreted in human
modes.description: The word milk right after 'excreted in/into human' in nursing-mother statements.
modes.example: It is not known whether atorvastatin is excreted into human<< milk>>; however a small amount of another drug

modes.label: Partway through excreted
modes.description: The middle of the word excreted in the same kind of sentence.
modes.example: It is not known whether rifabutin is ex<<cret>>ed in human milk.

modes.label: Breastfeeding wording
modes.description: The word feeding in breastfeeding within dosing instructions.
modes.example: Breast<<feeding>> and/or baby formula may be given on

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated multilingual pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word milk in the standard line about whether a drug passes into breast milk.
